{"m": "gpt-4o-mini", "msg": [{"content": "You compare short personal anecdotes by their underlying relational structure - the pattern of intentions, causes, deceptions, reversals, and outcomes among the people involved - NOT by their surface topic, setting, or vocabulary. Two stories can be about totally different situations yet share the same deep structure; two stories can share the same topic yet have opposite structure.", "role": "system"}, {"content": "SITUATION:
I wrote the entire grant proposal that funded our department for three years. My department head presented it to the university president as her strategic vision. My name appeared nowhere in the materials. When the president congratulated her, she accepted graciously and mentioned 'staff support.'

CANDIDATE A:
As a teenager, I ghostwrote my pastor's sermons when he was overwhelmed. He delivered them as divine inspiration received in prayer. Years later, parishioners still quote 'his' words to me. I smile and nod while hearing my own sentences praised back to me.

CANDIDATE B:
I developed a new inventory system that saved the company thousands monthly. My manager credited me specifically in the quarterly review. The CEO mentioned my contribution in the shareholder meeting.

Which candidate shares the same underlying relational structure as the SITUATION (ignore surface topic similarity)? Respond as JSON: {"choice": "A" or "B", "reason": "<one sentence>"}.", "role": "user"}], "t": 0.0, "tag": "exp2:44"}
content: {"choice": "A", "reason": "Both the SITUATION and Candidate A involve a lack of recognition for the true contributor, where the original creator's work is presented by someone else as their own, leading to a disconnect between intention and acknowledgment."}
